Domain controller lockout policy tightened (account lockout threshold reduced, lockout duration increased).

recommendations: Continue monitoring for additional failed authentication attempts.
Review partner VPN access policies and enforce MFA.
Implement rate limiting on Kerberos TGT requests.
Update detection rule to trigger on >5 failed TGTs within 5 minutes from same source.
